text: {"hints":["Check page 109 where a custom manager class is defined and see how the get_queryset method is overridden to filter by Post.Status.PUBLISHED.","Make sure to reference the Post model (or its Status enum) inside the manager as shown in the example, so the filter can access the correct constant.","Add the default manager objects = models.Manager() before your custom manager, as explained on page 110, to keep the standard manager available.","Assign your custom manager to a field named published in the Post model; then you can use Post.published.all() to retrieve only published posts."]}
